The '''Zebitrope system''' was a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated at the endpoint of the [[Cadma Conduit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Cadma system/Legends|Cadma system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Zebitrope [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained<ref name="Gamer5" /> the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Zebitrope IV]] and [[Zebitrope VIII]], which occupied the fourth and eighth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] positions, respectively.<ref name="EotE" />

Zebitrope IV was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a<ref name="CSWE Zebitrope">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zebitrope IV}}</ref> rare<ref name="Gamer5" /> [[Unidentified lizard (Zebitrope IV)|species]] of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]<ref name="CSWE Zebitrope" /> that could also be found on Zebitrope VIII.<ref name="EotE" /> The lizards had a symbiotic relationship with a type of [[Unidentified mold|mold]]<ref name="CSWE Zebitrope" /> that only grew on the [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles']] backs.<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> The [[Fungus/Legends|mold]] was the only source of<ref name="CSWE Zebitrope" /> the valuable and illegal drug [[Lesai/Legends|lesai]], which was exported to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. They regularly visited Zebitrope VIII after completing the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-trafficking route known as the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]],<ref name="Gamer5" /> thereby leading to the route's extension ending at the Zebitrope system to be named the [[Kessel Hop]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zebitrope system was first mentioned in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', the [[1983]] second entry in [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="LCFO" /> The system's first full appearance came with the depiction of Zebitrope IV in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

[[File:Zebitrope-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|The noncanonical article "Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are" placed the Zebitrope system in the Zebitrope sector.]]
"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed the Zebitrope system in the [[Zebitrope sector]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' later placed Zebitrope IV in the "Dufilvan sector,"<ref name="SWR" /> a misspelling of the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]].<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently overrode the ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' placement by establishing that the Zebitrope system was situated in grid square T-8 as part of the Centrality.<ref name="TEA" />

Information from ''The Essential Atlas'' created an apparent contradiction<ref name="TEA" /> with the mention of Zebitrope IV in ''Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon''. The latter work describes a collection of spongy growths that could be found on Zebitrope IV as having originated on a planet "a quarter of a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] away" from the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oseon 6845]] of the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]],<ref name="LCFO" /> which ''The Essential Atlas'' places in the same sector as the Zebitrope system.<ref name="TEA" />
